[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- Display screen, remote control, correctly connected camera capable of outputting images

### Operation instructions

1. Press the [ENTER] button on the remote control to enter the login interface, enter the password "999999", and automatically log in to the main menu
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d5b925f82c02bdbb5700c036329c5e7b)

2. Select [Settings] on the main menu interface, and press the "ENTER" button to enter the settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0807931674b106d5adbc7aa15d9eb3a3)

3. Select [Basic Settings] in the [Settings] interface, and press the "ENTER" key to enter the basic settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d720d07702af312ecc1f5076cc8da36b)

4. Select [Mirror] in the [Basic Settings] interface, enter the mirror settings page, check the channel and direction to be mirrored, and press "OK" to save
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4bd90ff0271bb6cd2ca52381483ef28b)
ps: After configuration, you can immediately return to the real-time screen to view the effect
